text:
Predicates:
Premiered(x, y) ::: x premiered y.
Orchestra(x) ::: x is an orchestra.
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Conductor(x) ::: x is a conductor.
Wrote(x, y) ::: x wrote y.
MusicPiece(y) ::: y is a music piece.
Composes(x, y) ::: x composes y.
Question: ::: "Some orchestras premiered music pieces."

Premises:
MusicPiece(symphony9) ::: Symphony No. 9 is a music piece.
Wrote(beethoven, symphony9) ::: Beethoven wrote Symphony No. 9.
Premiered(viennaMusicSociety, symphony9) ::: Vienna Music Society premiered Symphony No. 9.
Orchestra(viennaMusicSociety) ::: Vienna Music Society is an orchestra.
Leads(beethoven, viennaMusicSociety) ::: Beethoven leads the Vienna Music Society.
Orchestra(x) ∧ Leads(conductor, x) ::: Orchestras are led by conductors.

Conclusion:
∃x ∃y (Orchestra(x) ∧ Premiered(x, y)) ::: Some orchestras premiered music pieces.
